general_pool_cloth_v1.label: 通用台球 · 较快台面参考

sliding_friction.basis: Rounded lower end of measured snooker sliding interval 0.178–0.245 in Mathavan et al. 2010 section 3.2, reporting their high-speed-camera experiments. Transfer reference, not a pool-brand measurement.

rolling_friction.basis: Engineering selection toward faster cloth within Alciatore published pool range 0.005–0.015. Defined here as effective linear deceleration / g, not tangential force / normal force. NOT a directly measured value for this table.

spin_deceleration.basis: Retained within published pool range 5–15 rad/s^2. Acts on vertical side spin only, never on draw/follow rotation.

provenance.other_parameters: Retain v3 cushion and ball research values; no claim of a jointly measured table.

general_pool_cloth_v1.scope: Generic cloth reference and documented tuning; not restricted to JOY or Liber Win. Phase A retains its historical v3 baseline.

general_pool_spin_v1.label: 通用台面与球球旋转摩擦参考

sliding_friction.basis: Rounded lower end of measured snooker sliding interval 0.178–0.245 in Mathavan et al. 2010 section 3.2, reporting their high-speed-camera experiments. Transfer reference, not a pool-brand measurement.

rolling_friction.basis: Engineering selection toward faster cloth within Alciatore published pool range 0.005–0.015. Defined here as effective linear deceleration / g, not tangential force / normal force. NOT a directly measured value for this table.

spin_deceleration.basis: Retained within published pool range 5–15 rad/s^2. Acts on vertical side spin only, never on draw/follow rotation.

provenance.other_parameters: Retain v3 cushion and ball research values; no claim of a jointly measured table.

ball_friction.basis: Equations 5-17, p4 speed fit: mu=a+b*exp(-c*surface_slip), a=.009951, b=.108, c=1.088. Marlow data as reproduced and fitted by Alciatore; not new original measurements. Horizontal projection only; vertical ball contact impulse and draw/follow spin transfer omitted.

multi_ball_contact.basis: Table 1: phenolic resin Young modulus 3800 MPa and Poisson ratio 0.375; Hertz sphere stiffness equation 3.4. Transfer reference, not direct measurements of the current balls. Damped Hertz force with exponent 1/4 follows the constant-restitution dimensional condition in Ramirez et al. 1999 section II (https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevE.60.4465); damping numerically matches e=0.95. Force-based contact in brief open-table networks, isolated CCD otherwise; cloth impulse omitted only during the bounded contact burst. Rail networks retain the documented rigid approximation.

general_pool_spin_v1.scope: Planar throw and z spin transfer. Hybrid CCD and short finite-duration Hertz contact bursts for ball networks away from boundaries. 2 microsecond midpoint integration; elastic overlap stores energy, no plastic rack support during the burst. Microgap positions are included during contact propagation. No hop or vertical ball contact impulse. Rail networks retain the rigid impulse approximation. Not jointly calibrated to real break footage.
